step: boil the sealed tin for hours

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The unopened tin of sweetened condensed milk is simmered fully under water, topped up as it drops.
The tin cools completely before it is opened, as it can burst while hot.

links.name: Recipes Are Simple: Dulce de leche from sweetened condensed milk

sources.text: That the sealed tin of sweetened condensed milk is boiled, and that industry heats it in autoclaves or reactors instead, from the first; the time of 2.5-3 hours and the keeping of the tin under water from the second.
